name: Kaizen
author: OpenDejenol
description: Casts each character's buff list on entering the dungeon, and heals the party before returning to town.

settings.label: Buff on entering the dungeon
settings.description: Casts each member's buff list from the Kaizen window on going down from town.

settings.label: Heal before returning to town
settings.description: Heals the party on the stairs up from level 1: spells first, then the guild crests that heal.
